name: Brightery Coupon Automation for WooCommerce
author: Brightery

sections.description:
Brightery Coupon Automation for WooCommerce

Automatically apply WooCommerce coupon codes when customers meet specific cart subtotal and product category conditions.

Brightery Auto Apply Coupons for WooCommerce helps online store owners automate discount campaigns without requiring customers to find, copy, or manually enter coupon codes.

Create flexible coupon rules, select qualifying product categories, define a minimum subtotal, and connect each rule to an existing WooCommerce coupon. When the customer’s cart meets the configured conditions, the coupon is applied automatically.

Turn WooCommerce Coupons Into Automated Sales Campaigns

Customers frequently abandon purchases because they forget a coupon code, cannot find the promotion, or do not understand whether they qualify for a discount.

Instead of asking customers to manually enter a promotional code, the plugin evaluates the shopping cart and applies the correct WooCommerce coupon automatically when the configured conditions are met.

This makes it easier to run campaigns such as:

  • Spend-based discounts
  • Category-specific promotions
  • Seasonal sales
  • Product collection offers
  • VIP discount campaigns
  • Mobile app promotions
  • Exclusive coupon campaigns

Main Features

Automatically Apply WooCommerce Coupons

Apply an existing WooCommerce coupon automatically when a customer’s cart meets your configured conditions.

Customers do not need to remember, copy, or manually enter the coupon code.

Category-Based Coupon Rules

Choose one or more WooCommerce product categories that should qualify for the discount.

You can create offers such as:

  • Spend $500 on skincare products and receive a discount
  • Purchase products from the electronics category and unlock a special coupon
  • Reach a minimum subtotal in selected categories and receive free shipping
  • Apply a seasonal promotion only to selected product collections
  • Spend $100 on accessories and automatically receive 10% off
  • Purchase from two selected categories and unlock a promotional coupon

When no category is selected, the rule can evaluate eligible products across the entire shopping cart.

Minimum Cart Subtotal Conditions

Set the minimum qualifying subtotal required before a coupon is automatically applied.

This allows you to create automated campaigns such as:

  • Save 10% when spending more than $100
  • Receive free shipping when the cart reaches $75
  • Unlock a category discount after spending $150
  • Receive $20 off when the cart subtotal reaches $200
  • Reward larger purchases automatically

Rule Priorities

Control which coupon rules should be evaluated first by assigning a priority to each rule.

Priority management is useful when your store has several promotions running at the same time.

For example, you can prioritize a VIP promotion over a general storewide discount or evaluate category-specific offers before broader cart promotions.

Exclusive Coupon Rules

Mark a rule as exclusive when the automated coupon should replace other coupons currently applied to the shopping cart.

When an exclusive rule qualifies, the configured coupon is applied and other active coupons are removed.

Enable or Disable Individual Rules

Temporarily disable a coupon rule without deleting its configuration.

This makes it easy to:

  • Pause seasonal campaigns
  • Prepare future promotions
  • Disable expired offers
  • Reuse previous campaigns
  • Test new coupon strategies
  • Manage several promotions from one location

Mobile App Context Rules

Create coupon rules that apply only when the request includes the supported mobile app context.

Examples include:

  • Mobile-app-only discounts
  • App launch promotions
  • Exclusive mobile customer coupons

Respect Customer Coupon Removal

When a customer manually removes an automatically applied coupon, the plugin remembers that choice during the current WooCommerce session.

The coupon will not be repeatedly forced back into the shopping cart during the same session.

This creates a more respectful and user-friendly shopping experience.

Uses Existing WooCommerce Coupons

The plugin works with coupons created through WooCommerce.

Create the coupon in WooCommerce, configure its discount amount and restrictions, and then enter its coupon code into your automation rule.

The plugin does not replace the WooCommerce coupon system. It extends it by adding automatic, rule-based coupon application.

You can continue using standard WooCommerce coupon settings such as:

  • Percentage discounts
  • Fixed cart discounts
  • Fixed product discounts
  • Minimum spending requirements
    Etc …

How It Works

  1. Create a coupon through WooCommerce.
  2. Open Coupon Automation in the WordPress dashboard.
  3. Create a new automation rule.
  4. Select the qualifying product categories.
  5. Enter the minimum required subtotal.
  6. Add the existing WooCommerce coupon code.
  7. Set the rule priority.

The plugin will evaluate the customer’s shopping cart and automatically apply the coupon when the configured requirements are met.

Example Coupon Campaigns

Spend $100 and Save 10%

Create a percentage discount coupon in WooCommerce, set the automation rule subtotal to $100, and connect the coupon code to the rule.

When the cart reaches $100, the coupon is applied automatically.

Spend $75 and Receive Free Shipping

Create a free-shipping coupon in WooCommerce and configure an automation rule with a minimum subtotal of $75.

Eligible customers receive the shipping coupon automatically without entering a code.

Spend $200 in Electronics and Save $25

Select the electronics category, enter a minimum qualifying subtotal of $200, and connect a fixed-cart discount coupon worth $25.

The coupon is applied when the subtotal of eligible electronics products reaches the required amount.

Mobile App Customers Receive 15% Off

Create a 15% discount coupon, enable the mobile app context restriction, and connect the coupon to an automation rule.

The promotion will only qualify when the request includes the supported app context.

Why Use Automatic Coupons?

Automatic coupon application can improve the shopping experience by reducing unnecessary steps during the cart and checkout process.

Customers can immediately see that they have qualified for an offer, which may help:

  • Reduce coupon-related confusion
  • Increase promotion visibility
  • Encourage customers to spend more
  • Improve campaign consistency
  • Reduce support questions about coupon eligibility
  • Prevent customers from forgetting promotional codes
  • Create smoother cart and checkout experiences
  • Control coupon stacking through exclusive rules
  • Improve mobile commerce promotions
  • Make discounts easier to understand
  • Increase the perceived value of promotions

Ideal For

Brightery Coupon Automation for WooCommerce is suitable for:

  • WooCommerce stores
  • Fashion and apparel websites
  • Beauty and skincare stores
  • Electronics retailers
  • Online pharmacies
  • Mobile commerce applications
    Etc …

Privacy-Friendly Design

The plugin does not collect or transmit personal customer information to external services.

Rule configurations are stored in the WordPress options table. Temporary coupon-removal preferences are stored in the existing WooCommerce customer session.

Plugin Policy

By downloading, installing, purchasing, or using this plugin, you agree to the Brightery WordPress Plugin Policy:

https://www.brightery.com/en/page/wordpress-plugin-policy

How does App Only work?

An App Only rule qualifies only when the request includes ?app=true. This is a context flag, not an authentication mechanism.

Does this plugin collect personal data?

No. The plugin stores rule settings in the WordPress options table and temporary coupon-removal flags in the existing WooCommerce customer session. It does not transmit data to external services.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and activated because the plugin uses the WooCommerce cart, coupon, product category, and customer session systems.

Does the plugin create new coupons?

No. Create and configure your coupon through WooCommerce first, then connect its code to an automation rule.

Can I automatically apply WooCommerce coupons?

Yes. The plugin automatically applies an existing WooCommerce coupon when the customer’s shopping cart meets your configured rule conditions.

Can I apply coupons to specific product categories?

Yes. You can select one or more WooCommerce product categories for each automation rule.

Can I apply a coupon to the entire shopping cart?

Yes. When no category is selected, the rule can evaluate the subtotal of eligible products across the entire cart.

Can I prevent customers from combining coupons?

Yes. Enable the exclusive option to apply the automated coupon and remove other currently applied coupons.

Can I temporarily pause a promotion?

Yes. Individual rules can be enabled or disabled without deleting their configuration.

What happens when a customer removes an automatic coupon?

The plugin respects the customer’s choice during the current WooCommerce session and does not continuously reapply the removed coupon.

Does the plugin support mobile app promotions?

Yes. Rules can be restricted to requests containing the supported mobile app context.

Is the mobile app context an authentication system?

No. The app context is a request flag used to identify supported mobile app requests. It is not an authentication or authorization mechanism.

Does the plugin send customer data to Brightery?

No. The plugin does not transmit customer information to Brightery or other external services.

Can I use the plugin for free shipping campaigns?

Yes. Create and configure a free-shipping coupon in WooCommerce, then connect it to an automation rule.
